summary: Iter11 Activity Log audit trail: middleware auto-logging (POST/PUT/DELETE) + explicit login/logout/login_failed logging work correctly and rows land in db.activity_log with correct action, resource, resource_label, user_email, IP, timestamp. Frontend nav gating (admin-only) works and page renders. This is exactly the bug the review note warned about (endpoints originally placed after app.include_router). The 'now fixed' claim in the agent-to-agent note is INCORRECT - endpoints were removed but not re-added.

Endpoint is completely missing from server.py. Returns 404. Purge button in UI cannot work. Must be added to api_router before include_router. Expected: admin-only, 400 when `before` missing, 403 for staff/guest.

integration_issues.issue: Toast 'Gagal load activity log: Not Found' shown because GET /api/activity-log returns 404. Empty state (Belum ada activity log) always displayed. Blocked by backend missing endpoints.

action_items: URGENT: Add GET /api/activity-log endpoint on api_router with admin-only guard, supporting query params action, resource, user_id, date_from, date_to, limit (default 500, max 2000). Sort by timestamp DESC. Exclude/stringify Mongo _id.
URGENT: Add DELETE /api/activity-log/purge?before=YYYY-MM-DD on api_router (admin-only). Return 400 if `before` missing, 403 for non-admin. Return {deleted: <count>}.
Ensure both endpoints are declared BEFORE `app.include_router(api_router)` (server.py:2228). Current file has NO occurrence of these routes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2241 lines - should be split into routers (auth.py, barang.py, po.py, activity_log.py, etc.) per <=700 lines guideline.
Activity log entries include Mongo _id (ObjectId); when GET endpoint is added ensure _id is stringified or excluded to avoid JSON serialization errors.
Middleware reads request.client.host directly - behind ingress this often shows internal LB IP. Consider X-Forwarded-For header.
Middleware skips /api/upload but not /api/export - export endpoints (POST for PDF/Excel) would be logged as create; may be intentional or noise.

rca_of_the_issue: The two admin endpoints (`@api_router.get('/activity-log')` and `@api_router.delete('/activity-log/purge')`) referenced in the review request at 'line ~2228-2270' do NOT exist in the current server.py. `grep -n activity /app/backend/server.py` shows only middleware + login/logout inserts. The file ends at line 2241 with `app.include_router(api_router)` and CORS setup - no route definitions in between. Reproduction: `curl -b <cookie> $BASE/api/activity-log` -> 404 Not Found. Mitigation: Main agent must add both endpoints on api_router before include_router, with admin-role guard, filter query params, and ObjectId-safe serialization.
